title: Zucchini, Pea and Feta Pasta
subtitle: with Zesty Lemon and Mint
description: Smacking with fresh mint, green veggies and zesty lemon, this satisfying bowl of pasta topped with creamy feta is everything we love about summer.

steps.text: Prep zucchini: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Thinly slice the zucchini lengthwise, stack the slices, cut into thin strips, then halve crosswise.

Prep ingredients: Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Finely grate half the lemon zest, then juice the half into a separate bowl (the remaining lemon won't be used in this dish). Finely chop the mint, reserving a few leaves to serve and discarding stalks.

Cook pasta and peas: Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 6 mins. Add the peas and cook for a further 2 mins or until the peas are tender and the pasta is al dente. Drain, then return the pasta and peas to the pan and cover to keep warm.

Cook zucchini: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over high heat. Cook the zucchini, stirring, for 1-2 mins until golden. Reduce the heat to low, add the garlic and lemon zest, season with salt and pepper, and cook for a further 1-2 mins until tender. Remove from heat.

Combine and serve up: Crumble the feta. Add half the feta to the pasta and peas and cook, stirring, over medium heat for 1-2 mins until the feta is melted. Add the zucchini mixture, chopped mint and lemon juice, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Divide the pasta among bowls and scatter with the remaining feta and reserved mint leaves to serve.
Spice it up: If like a little heat with your pasta, add a small pinch of dried chilli flakes when you fry the garlic and lemon zest.
